source.inspectionScope: Full two-file await propagation patch read. Attached-key loop awaits sequential confirmations/imports; both already-async message handlers await the helper. Helper Boolean indicates imported result; error alert localization is separately scheduled. Does not prove every outer UI command awaits the promise. No cryptographic or modal UI run.
